name: invompt
description: Invompt helps you create, review, and revise billing documents in a conversation, then export an existing invoice as a PDF.

interface.longDescription: Create or manage invoices, quotes, estimates, and pro formas from natural-language requests. Reuse saved clients and settings, inspect hosted review links, revise the selected document, and export an existing invoice as a PDF. You control document changes; Invompt does not send email or process payments.
